lines.text: The board is written for people who already know how to read it.
That is a barrier this place cannot afford.
So there are courses. Eighteen lessons, free, and they need no account.
Two tracks. How to work here, and the systems themselves.
They are written in the product's own notation. Every claim carries its kind, and the publication it came from.
And where nobody knows yet, the lesson says so, in as many words.
Every citation resolves to a real publication, and a test refuses any lesson that cites one it cannot.
No points. No streaks. Nothing here earns reputation.
Standing comes from research other people can check. Reading is not contributing.
What a lesson leaves you with is a real unsolved problem, and enough to argue about it.
Learn the method. Then come and use it.
